facts.fact: UNHCR reports 29,233 refugees registered on an individual basis with DAARA in 2024 and 5,014 people assisted with civil status documents.

UNHCR says enrolment of asylum-seekers in the National Register of Physical Persons (RNPP) of ONECI has been approved for 2025, with a plan to transfer biometric data to ONECI to issue a unique identifier.
